title: Detailed magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='58' y='62' width='12' height='34' rx='6' fill='#8B4513' transform='rotate(-45 64 79)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='64' width='4' height='28' rx='2' fill='#C4722A' transform='rotate(-45 64 79)'/>
  <!-- ferrule connecting handle to ring -->
  <rect x='52' y='56' width='14' height='12' rx='4' fill='#D4AF37' transform='rotate(-45 59 62)'/>
  <rect x='54' y='58' width='5' height='8' rx='2' fill='#F5E28A' transform='rotate(-45 59 62)'/>
  <!-- outer ring -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='28' fill='none' stroke='#D4AF37' stroke-width='9'/>
  <!-- ring highlight -->
  <path d='M 18 30 A 24 24 0 0 1 34 16' fill='none' stroke='#F5E28A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ring darker inner shade -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='28' fill='none' stroke='#A8862A' stroke-width='2' stroke-dasharray='4 170' stroke-dashoffset='-40'/>
  <!-- lens glass -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='23.5' fill='#BFE8FF' fill-opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- glass shine -->
  <path d='M 24 26 A 20 20 0 0 1 36 18' fill='none' stroke='#EAF9FF' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='3' fill='#EAF9FF' fill-opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- refraction glint -->
  <path d='M 30 48 A 18 18 0 0 0 46 54' fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
